# @nexocache/cache

> 标签: cache, cache-invalidation, cache-manager, cache-tags, caching, decorator, distributed-cache, express, fastify, ioredis, lru, memoize, nestjs, redis, stale-while-revalidate, stampede, swr, thundering-herd, ttl, typescript

## 简介

Production-grade, framework-agnostic caching for Node.js. Type-safe, decorator-friendly, with tags, stampede protection and pluggable stores.
